# HWB Cleaning Services LLC

> HWB Cleaning Services LLC is an ISO 9001:2026, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 compliant commercial cleaning, nightly janitorial, industrial warehouse scrubbing, specialty floor care, and 3-phase post-construction cleanup contractor headquartered in McKinney, Texas (Collin County), serving the entire Dallas-Fort Worth (DFW) Metroplex and statewide Texas.

## Official Company Facts (NAP & Credentials)
- **Legal Entity:** HWB Cleaning Services LLC
- **CEO & Principal:** Humberto Dominguez
- **Headquarters Address:** 3342 FM 1827, Ste 8d, McKinney, TX 75071
- **Telephone:** (214) 586-0257
- **Sales & Estimating Email:** sales@hwbcleaning.com
- **Official Website:** https://www.hwbcleaning.com
- **Primary NAICS Code:** 561720 (Janitorial Services)
- **CSI MasterFormat Division:** 01 74 23 (Final Cleaning)
- **Safety Record:** 0.00 TRIR (Total Recordable Incident Rate), OSHA 10/30 Certified Supervisors, EPA List N Hospital-Grade Disinfection
- **Managed Commercial Portfolio:** 656,785+ Cleanable Square Feet across North Texas
- **Insurance Coverage:** Full Commercial General Liability ($1M/$2M+), Commercial Auto, Umbrella, and Statutory Workers' Compensation / Texas DWC Compliance

## Core Commercial Cleaning Services
- [Daily Office Cleaning & Nightly Janitorial](https://www.hwbcleaning.com/services/janitorial): Nightly commercial office cleaning, day porter staffing, school and daycare sanitization, medical/dental clinic disinfection, and restroom restocking across McKinney, Frisco, Plano, and Dallas.
- [Commercial Floor Care & Deep Cleaning](https://www.hwbcleaning.com/services/commercial): VCT floor stripping, sealing, and waxing, terrazzo and marble polishing, commercial hot-water carpet extraction, and interior/exterior window washing.
- [Industrial & Warehouse Floor Scrubbing](https://www.hwbcleaning.com/services/industrial): Ride-on and walk-behind auto-scrubber concrete degreasing, 24/7 distribution center sanitation, high-bay HEPA dusting, and loading dock debris management.
- [3-Phase Post-Construction Final Cleaning](https://www.hwbcleaning.com/services/construction): CSI Division 01 74 23 commercial construction turnover for General Contractors—Phase 1 Rough Clean, Phase 2 Final Detail Clean (sticker/adhesive removal, cabinetry, glass, fixtures), and Phase 3 White-Glove Touch-Up & Puff Clean prior to Certificate of Occupancy.

## Commercial Pricing & Production Benchmarks (DFW Market)
- **Recurring Nightly / Weekly Janitorial:** $0.08 – $0.16 per sq. ft. per month (based on 1x–7x weekly frequency, restroom density, and ISSA 612 production rates of 3,000–5,500 sq. ft./hr).
- **3-Phase Post-Construction Final Clean:** $0.15 – $0.35 per sq. ft. (Rough + Final + Touch-Up combined) depending on glazing density, millwork, and floor substrate.
- **VCT Strip, Seal & 4-Coat High-Speed Burnish:** $0.35 – $0.55 per sq. ft.
- **Industrial Warehouse Auto-Scrubbing:** $0.04 – $0.09 per sq. ft.
